caption: MCP Related Task Metadata
description:
Metadata for associating messages with a task.
Include this in the `_meta` field under the key `io.modelcontextprotocol/related-task`. Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2025-11-25 RelatedTaskMetadata).
name: mcp_related_task_metadata
